title: Add invocation-chain-annotator and alert sanity dashboard
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Adds an invocation-chain annotator service and a new Alert Sanity dashboard for SREs to quickly triage noisy alerts; no public API changes.
body:
Context and motivation: Production SLOs were repeatedly inundated by alerts that originated from complex multi-stage invocations where the cost/latency signal was amplified by fan-out and retries. Root cause investigation was slow because traces and token-cost metrics live in separate views and there was no compact surface that summarizes 'chain shape' (fan-out, retry depth, KV-cache warm vs cold, and per-stage token cost) alongside an alert noise signal. This PR introduces a lightweight invocation-chain-annotator that computes a compact chain fingerprint and emits per-invocation annotations (chain_shape, primary_hot_stage, estimated_token_cost, is_prefetch_candidate) that are attached to sampled traces and metrics. It also adds an Alert Sanity dashboard (Grafana) for SREs/product engineers to triage noisy alerts quickly.

What this changes (high level): - New microservice: telemetry/invocation-annotator: consumes sampled invocation events, computes a compact chain fingerprint and per-stage summaries, writes annotations to trace index and metrics backends. - Instrumentation: runtime adds sparse markers into spans to emit stage boundaries (already gated behind a runtime flag). - Metrics: new counters/histograms: invocation_chain_count, chain_fanout_histogram, chain_retry_depth, chain_estimated_token_cost_histogram, alert_sanity_noise_index (per-route). - Dashboard: grafana/observability/alert_sanity_dashboard.json and an accompanying README with runbook links. - Tests: unit tests for annotator logic and integration smoke test that wires a synthetic invocation through the annotator and verifies annotations appear in the trace and metric stubs. - Rollout: feature-flagged on by default in canary region, gradual global rollout with backpressure limits.

Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-5128) linked - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] dashboard + runbook - [x] canary rollout plan - [x] CI green

Commits summary: 1) add invocation-chain-annotator service skeleton and proto definitions 2) implement chain fingerprint algorithm and stage summarizer 3) runtime span markers and small SDK helpers to annotate spans 4) emit compact annotations to trace index and metrics facade 5) add grafana dashboard JSON and README 6) tests and CI flakiness fixes

Files changed (high level): - telemetry/annotator/main.go (new service) - telemetry/annotator/chain_fingerprint.go - runtime/span_markers.go - telemetry/metrics/metrics_definitions.prom - grafana/dashboards/alert_sanity_dashboard.json - docs/observability/alert_sanity_runbook.md - tests/integration/annotator_smoke_test.go - ci/workflows/annotator-integration.yml

Testing and validation: Local unit tests added; CI integration job spins up a minimal annotator and synthetic trace generator (uses existing test harness). Load-simulated runs show annotator adds ~0.6ms median processing overhead per sampled invocation at 95th percentile for canary throughput; annotator backs off when event backlog exceeds threshold. Benchmarks included in telemetry/annotator/benchmarks.md. Dashboard was previewed in staging and validated with synthetic noisy alerts; screenshots included in runbook.

Rollout plan: Merge -> enable feature flag in canary (us-west-2) -> 24h observation window for alert noise index -> if stable, enable in remaining regions at 10%/hour increments with a kill-switch. Backout plan: disable runtime span markers and stop annotator via autoscaling policy; metric annotations expire within 24h TTL.

Notes for reviewers: The fingerprint algorithm uses a deterministic shingle on stage opcodes plus stage token counts; collision risk is low for our cardinality (measured in dev harness). We intentionally keep annotations small (max 128 bytes) to avoid trace index bloat. Comments welcome on the chosen shrinkage heuristics and thresholds in chain_fingerprint.go.
commits: chore(runtime): add span markers and SDK helpers
feat(metrics): emit compact chain annotations to metrics facade
docs(grafana): add alert sanity dashboard & runbook
test(integration): add annotator smoke test and fixtures
reviews: Miguel Alvarez: Left a few nits on chain_fingerprint.go around naming and a suggestion to extract shrink heuristics to a config struct; overall good direction and +1 once addressed.

Priya Narayanan: Requested changes on dashboard: add a compact table view for top-10 noisy routes and a link to the runbook; noted we should throttle dashboard refreshes for large orgs; approved after dashboard tweak.

Liam O'Connor: Noted concerns about annotator memory usage under burst failures; asked for a backpressure limit and a metric to expose annotator queue depth; author added queue depth metric and updated tests; approved.

Sofia Patel: Addressed reviewer comments and pushed a follow-up commit that extracts heuristics to config, adds annotator.queue_depth metric, and updates dashboard to include top-10 table and runbook link.
